key_impacts: Harbor walls were overtopped and break walls submerged.
Shoreline and nearby city streets were flooded.
Shoreline homes/cottages and public/boat docks were damaged.
Water intake pumps at a hydroelectric facility were impacted by rapid level changes.
Water level fluctuations up to 2 m were reported outside the harbor; 0.5 m recorded at the harbor gauge.
evidence_snippets: April 13, 2018, meteotsunami waves struck the Michigan coastline near Ludington.
Harbor walls overtopped; shoreline homes and boat docks damaged; water intake pumps impacted.
NWS received reports of 2 m water level fluctuations just outside the harbor.
missing_information: Exact counts of damaged homes/docks not provided.
Other specifically named affected settlements beyond Ludington not listed.
